svg.aria-label: CoolSynth V3 engine architecture. Keys and MIDI feed a note layer of chord memory, arpeggiator and play mode. Each of two parts is a complete synth: per voice three generator slots that can sync, ring, FM or AM one another, three processor slots in series and an amplifier, then three insert effects. Modulation sources and a 24-routing matrix feed the voice from below. Both parts are mixed into a master effect section, gain, soft clipper and stereo out. Three lists give the 9 generator types, 7 processor types and 12 effects a slot can hold; three notes describe the Museum, the Conservatory and 2x voices.

svg.text: Sine, triangle, saw and pulse as one morph, PWM, sub, unison of up to 7 on a JP-8000-style
detune curve. Band-limited edges, also under hard sync: saw aliasing −79 dB at 3.5 kHz.

Two sine operators: ratio 0.25 to 16, index up to 10 radians, self-feedback.
Four operators, 6 algorithms, feedback; each operator plays one of the TX81Z’s 8 waves.
4 tables of 16 frames with position morph; unison of up to 5. Every frame is kept at 11 band
Plucked-string model: decay, damping, pick position, a noise or a fingertip pluck, a damper on
release. Stays in tune however dark the damping.
12 struck partials. Material morphs from wood (a marimba bar, 1 : 4 : 10.1 : 19.1, measured on
a recording) through metal and glass to a tine. Mallet hardness, strike position.
Plays the Conservatory’s recorded instruments (16-point sinc read), or 5 factory loops.
A cloud of up to 12 grains per voice from a sample: position, scan (0 freezes it), size, density,
Planned: your own wavetables and samples; grains from a live generator.
4-pole transistor ladder with saturation in every stage. LP24, LP12, BP,
HP12. Self-oscillates from its own noise floor, within 3.3 cents of the
cutoff (250 Hz to 4 kHz). Generator 3 can modulate the cutoff at audio
rate, up to 3 octaves either way.
2-pole state-variable filter: low-pass, high-pass, band-pass, notch. Q
Feedback comb tuned to the key: tune, damping, either polarity.

Sine wavefolder with up to 30 dB of drive and symmetry; anti-aliased.
1 to 16 bits, continuous; sample-and-hold down to 1 kHz.
Soft, hard or tube curve with tone; anti-aliased.

svg.text: Every voice is computed at twice the sample rate and brought
FM2 and FM4 also hold the index, note by note, where the first
sideband that would fold back into the audible band stays under
−80 dB. Low and middle notes never reach the limit.
Measured: with index 10 asked for on a 2 kHz carrier, the largest
alias below 20 kHz sits at −75 dB.
Changing a slot’s type under a held note crossfades in 5 ms;
nothing else in the patch moves.
